reviewed_snapshot.kind: reviewed portable snapshot; not a raw resume input

protocol.common_preprocessing: training mean and full covariance whitening; fixed for validation/test
protocol.density: two-fold cross-fitting on original training inputs, no law or nu supplied
protocol.family_selection: training-only BIC Gaussian versus bounded Student with fitted nu/variance
protocol.estimated_initializer: best validation rule among fitted scores of degree two/four
protocol.rule: 24 symmetric-band partitions per basis, inherited frozen trainer
protocol.selection: validation log loss; test once for each selected predictor
limits: six synthetic tasks, five fresh independent draws; not a general tabular SOTA comparison
rank-two symmetric-band grammar is supplied; this is not arbitrary symbolic discovery
fitted scores and whitening are plug-in estimates; no exact unbiasedness or recovery guarantee
extra validation search selects the estimated initializer and is shared by both profiles
ordinary Gaussian profiles receive exactly the same geometry, head seeds and training grid
full-U sign-label initialization is included to close the prior study omission
no runtime, memory, certification or novelty claim from this learning study

protocol.known_input: Gaussian N(0,I), no sample whitening; Student-t violates this assumption
limits: restricted rank-two symmetric-band grammar, not universal symbolic discovery
24 rule candidates versus 3 trials per neural/SVM model; unequal compute
only Algorithm 1 with k=2/4 binary RBF labels, not full sequential Algorithm 2
mathematical unbiasedness does not enclose floating arithmetic
three independent dataset draws, small pilot not significance claim
shared estimator timings do not imply independent time-to-target comparisons

protocol.gaussian_control: fixed FWHM matched to collapsed sech-squared profile
protocol.centers: four unconditional training projection quantiles per direction
protocol.training: all normals, centers and head weights updated; profile scale fixed
limits: synthetic draws and real tasks absent from first pilot
rank-truncated SAVE and Gaussian score functions are existing methods
Gaussian score interpretation need not hold on real data
no post-test hyperparameter changes; no significance claim
